You are rebuilding the ConvertScan landing page from scratch to look like a premium, brand-level SaaS landing page — NOT an AI-generated or "vibe coded" template. ## Project Context - Path: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT - Stack: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui - ConvertScan is an AI-powered CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) audit tool - Users paste a URL and get instant, scored analysis with AI-generated suggestions - framer-motion is now installed (just added) - shadcn/ui components are at `@/components/ui/` - UrlInput component at `@/components/shared/UrlInput.tsx` (accepts size="lg", buttonText prop) - ScoreRing component at `@/components/shared/ScoreRing.tsx` (accepts score, size, strokeWidth, showLabel) - CRO_PILLARS from `@/lib/constants` (each has key, label, description, weight, icon) - getScoreHex from `@/lib/score-utils` - Primary color: indigo/purple (hsl 239 70% 58%) - Font: Inter (400, 500, 600, 700) - The `src/components/landing/` directory exists but is empty ## What's Wrong With Current Landing Page The current Landing.tsx (811 lines, single file) looks like every AI-generated SaaS template: - Same "badge + heading + paragraph + grid" pattern repeated for EVERY section - Generic gradient blobs (bg-primary/[0.04] blur-3xl) as backgrounds - No visual variety between sections - No animation at all - Everything centered with identical spacing - No social proof in first fold - Mock testimonials with initials look fake - No brand personality or visual differentiation ## Design Direction — Premium Brand Level ### Hero Section (DARK background) - Full-width dark section (bg-slate-950 or similar very dark blue-black) - Subtle animated grid/dot pattern in background (CSS only, no images) - Small pill badge at top: "Trusted by 500+ marketing teams" with a subtle glow - MASSIVE headline (text-5xl to text-7xl): "Stop guessing why visitors leave." — clean, bold, no gradient text gimmicks - Subheading: concise, 1-2 lines, light gray (slate-400) - UrlInput component centered, with a subtle glow/shadow around it - Below the input: "No signup required · Free forever · 30-second results" - Below that: A floating product screenshot/mockup of the dashboard in a browser chrome frame, slightly rotated/tilted with perspective, with a subtle shadow. Use the mock audit report data to create this inline (not an image) - Stats strip at the bottom of hero: "2,400+ Pages Audited | 7 CRO Pillars | 40+ Checks Per Page" — horizontal, with dividers ### Logo/Trust Bar - Simple horizontal strip: "Trusted by teams at" with generic company type logos (just use text-based pills like "SaaS Startups", "E-commerce", "Agencies", "Enterprise", "DTC Brands" styled as subtle outlined pills) - Light background, subtle border top/bottom ### What We Find Section (Findings) - Use a BENTO GRID layout (not a vertical list) - 3 finding cards in a 2-col + 1-col asymmetric grid (first card spans full width or 2 cols) - Each finding card has the severity badge, title, description, and fix - Cards have subtle hover animations (framer-motion scale + shadow) - Section heading should be left-aligned, not centered ### How It Works - Horizontal 3-step with numbered circles connected by a line - Each step has an icon, number, title, and description - Use framer-motion to animate steps into view on scroll (staggered) - Clean white background ### 7 CRO Pillars - 2-row grid (4+3 or 3+4) with ALL 7 pillars shown - Each card has icon, name, weight badge, and a one-line description - Cards have glass morphism effect (bg-white/60 backdrop-blur border-white/20) - Subtle hover: card lifts slightly ### Audit Preview - Full-width section with dark background - Browser mockup showing the audit report (like current but more polished) - Left side: mockup, Right side: feature bullets - Use framer-motion for scroll-triggered reveal ### Social Proof / Testimonials - 3 testimonial cards in a row - Each card: quote, role title, company type - Cards have subtle border, clean design - NO quote icons — use quotation marks in the text itself - Real-looking layout (photo placeholder = colored avatar circle with initials) ### Final CTA - Full-width dark gradient section (slate-950 to primary dark) - Bold headline: "Every hour without a CRO audit costs you conversions." - UrlInput below - Subtle animated gradient border or glow effect ### Footer - Clean 4-column footer on dark background - Brand, Product, Company, Legal columns - Social icons (X, LinkedIn, GitHub) - Copyright line ## Technical Requirements 1. Create modular components in `src/components/landing/`: - `LandingNavbar.tsx` - `Hero.tsx` - `LogoBar.tsx` - `Findings.tsx` - `HowItWorks.tsx` - `Pillars.tsx` - `AuditPreview.tsx` - `Testimonials.tsx` - `FinalCTA.tsx` - `LandingFooter.tsx` 2. Use framer-motion for: - Scroll-triggered fade-in animations (useInView + motion.div) - Staggered children animations - Subtle hover effects on cards - Hero elements animating in on load - Keep animations SUBTLE and professional — not flashy 3. Use existing shadcn/ui components (Button, Badge, Card, Separator) 4. Keep existing UrlInput and ScoreRing components — import and use them 5. All TypeScript strict, no `any` 6. Mobile responsive (mobile-first) 7. Import pattern for framer-motion: ```tsx import { motion, useInView } from "framer-motion"; ``` 8. For scroll animations, use this pattern: ```tsx const ref = useRef(null); const isInView = useInView(ref, { once: true, margin: "-100px" }); ``` 9. After creating all components, rewrite `src/pages/Landing.tsx` to import and compose them: ```tsx import LandingNavbar from "@/components/landing/LandingNavbar"; import Hero from "@/components/landing/Hero"; // etc. const Landing = () => (
); ``` ## IMPORTANT Design Rules - NO gradient text on headlines — use solid white on dark, solid foreground on light - NO decorative gradient blobs — use subtle grid patterns or clean backgrounds - NO "badge + centered heading + paragraph" pattern for every section — vary the layout - Use ASYMMETRIC layouts where appropriate (left-aligned headings, bento grids) - Use generous whitespace — premium brands breathe - Dark sections should use slate-950/900, not primary color backgrounds - Keep animations under 0.6s duration - Cards should have real depth (shadow-lg or shadow-xl) not flat - Typography should be BOLD and LARGE for headings (text-5xl+ on desktop) Build all 10 component files and rewrite Landing.tsx. Make it look like a $10M SaaS company's landing page, not a weekend project.
